relationships.evidence_quote: Casticin reduced IL-17 entry into the TNC, suppressed inflammatory mediator release, decreased CGRP levels, inhibited microglial inflammatory polarization, reduced the level of glycolysis.

relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, casticin markedly inhibited the PKM2-STAT3/NF-κB axis in the TNC, which jointly validated by WB and immunofluorescence colocalization.

key_findings: Casticin alleviated pain sensitization and migraine-like symptoms in NTG rats by inhibiting IL-17-mediated microglial polarization and glycolysis via the PKM2-STAT3/NF-κB axis.
SR1001 and brodalumab reversed the effects of casticin in vivo and in vitro.
